newsitem.title: RUSSIA: UES consolidated 1996 Russian pretax 11 trln rbls.
newsitem.headline: UES consolidated 1996 Russian pretax 11 trln rbls.

text.p: Consolidated profit at Unified Energy System (UES), Russia's largest company by sales, were 11.049 trillion roubles in 1996, the company's director for asset management said on Tuesday.
Consolidated sales were 116.7 trillion roubles, Alexander Lopatin said. The company did not calculate consolidated figures on an accruals basis in 1995, he added.
The consolidated figures represent total sales and profits from UES and its holdings with sales and profits from regional companies based proportionally on UES's equity stakes.

Lopatin said the figures did not account for financial dealings between UES and regional power companies in which it has a stake, including sales between UES and the regionals, profits and expenses from such dealings and dividends paid to UES by the regional companies.
The accounts were not made or audited by Price Waterhouse, UES's international accountant.
UES has controlling stakes in most of Russia's regional power utilities. It also has stakes in generating companies and owns and operates the national power grid.
UES's unconsolidated net profit, based on dividends and sales to regional utilities for use of its national power grid, was 469 billion roubles in 1996, up from 422 billion in 1995.
Unconsolidated pretax profit was 745 billion roubles after 622 billion in 1995 on sales of 8.95 trillion after 6.23 trillion roubles.
